sloka: युद्ध्यतामेव तेषां तु तदा वानररक्षसाम् ।रविरस्तं गतो रात्रिः प्रवृत्ता प्राणहारिणी ।। ६.४४.१ ।।।।
transliteration: yuddhyatāmeva teṣāṁ tu tadā vānararakṣasām ।ravirastaṁ gato rātriḥ pravṛttā prāṇahāriṇī ।। 6.44.1 ।।।।

translations.english: Thus, as the Vanaras and Rakshasas were battling, the Sun began to set, which is not favourable to the life of Vanaras.
